description: Synthesises a multi-speaker dialogue from a list of {text, voice} pairs, up to 10 entries (ElevenLabs).

apply_text_normalization.description: Text normalization mode. 'auto' lets the system decide, 'on' always applies normalization, 'off' skips it.

text.description: Text content for the dialogue entry.

voice_id.description: Voice ID for the dialogue entry. Resolve a friendly key via ELEVENLABS_VOICE_CODES or pass a custom voice_id. Available voices: Roger (male, american); Sarah (female, american); Laura (female, american); Charlie (male, australian); George (male, british); Callum (male, american); River (neutral, american); Harry (male, american); Liam (male, american); Alice (female, british); Matilda (female, american); Will (male, american); Jessica (female, american); Eric (male, american); Bella (female, american); Chris (male, american); Brian (male, american); Daniel (male, british); Lily (female, british); Adam (male, american); Bill (male, american).

language_code.description: ISO-639-1 or ISO-639-3 language code (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fra'). Leave empty for automatic detection.

stability.description: Voice stability. Lower values give broader emotional range, higher values produce more consistent but potentially monotonous speech.
